title: The Price of a Queen
setup: You gave up the queen on d1 to drag the black king to e7, and now three of your pieces are looking at it.
hint: Count the squares the king has, then find the piece that takes the last one while giving check.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Nd5#}} is Légal's Mate. The bishop on f7 and the knight on e5 cover d7, e6 and e8, so the second knight checks while taking f6 away itself. A queen is worth nothing next to a king with no squares.
